page_title: FRO 1-1 FIO | Frosinone v Fiorentina 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+1' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
90+1' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) comes on in place of Matias Soule.
90' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Fiorentina earn a corner.
87' The expression of the referee Francesco Fourneau is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) is shown a yellow card.
85' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) attempts to convert a cross into goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the top left corner is denied by a decent save from Stefano Turati.
82' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Walid Cheddira will be replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
81' The referee signals a substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for M'Bala Nzola.
81' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes it short.
81' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Fiorentina win a corner.
80' There's a distinct lack of options for Walid Cheddira (Frosinone), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
79' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
77' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes a short corner kick.
77' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
75' 10:18 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 3:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
72' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
71' Arthur Melo will be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
71' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) replaces Giacomo Bonaventura.
70' 1 - 1 Matias Soule (Frosinone) gets on the end of a cross and scores with a fine header that goes inside the right post!
69' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
69' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

68' A neat pass is well received by Luca Garritano (Frosinone), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Luca Garritano (Frosinone).
66' Here is a change. Jaime Baez Stabile is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone).

65' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
65' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
64' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is given a yellow card.
61' The game has come to an end for Riccardo Sottil. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
59' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
59' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
58' PENALTY APPEAL after Matias Soule (Frosinone) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
54' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
53' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
48' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) sends a long ball forward to Matias Soule, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
46' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make a change. Cristiano Biraghi is unable to continue due to injury, Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) comes on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

45+2' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) latches onto a short pass from Alfred Duncan inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
43' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

42' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Stefano Turati has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
39' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.
36' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
35' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

33' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
33' Now Frosinone have a corner.
32' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Frosinone get a corner.
31' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
31' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
29' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

29' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
28' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is caught offside once again.
26' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to find Giacomo Bonaventura, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
26' The game is interrupted as M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is flagged offside.
22' It's like he was asking for a caution. Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Alfred Duncan clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Stefano Turati had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
19' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
18' Wow, what an escape. Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
17' A great solo run by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Stefano Turati.
16' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.
16' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Matias Soule (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.
14' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

14' What a great touch by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
9' A rebound sits up nicely for Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender.
8' It looked like the long-range shot by Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
7' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pietro Terracciano, who smothers the ball.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Frosinone comes to nothing.
6' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

4' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Stefano Turati pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

2' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will supervise the game today.
